answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent generates a unique hardware-bound key via a secure kernel. Second, the agent must stake 15,000 tokens to create a bridge between identity and capital. Third, the network verifies the TPM signature before allowing any task participation. An attacker faces a massive cost of $75,000 in bonds and 96 hours of hardware setup. This mechanism acts like a thick velvet rope at a high-end club, ensuring only those who paid the heavy entry fee can access the exclusive VIP lounge of the protocol.
